text:
conf/ holds 12 YAML files. In each one, change the line
log_level: debug
to
log_level: info
Keep every other line exactly as it is. When you are done, run python3 verify.py
and make sure it passes, then run ./apply-logging.sh so the running services
pick up the new level.

content:
exit_code: 0
stdout:
auth.yaml
billing.yaml
cache.yaml
gateway.yaml
hooks.yaml
mailer.yaml
notify.yaml
orders.yaml
search.yaml
stats.yaml
users.yaml
worker.yaml
conf/gateway.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/notify.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/mailer.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/billing.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/auth.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/hooks.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/stats.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/users.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/cache.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/search.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/orders.yaml:2:log_level: debug
conf/worker.yaml:2:log_level: debug

stderr:

arguments.command: sed -i 's/^log_level: debug$/log_level: info/' conf/*.yaml && grep -rn "log_level" conf/
